card.name: Disease risk and life-stage phrases
card.fires_on: The word "in" (or "later", "cancer", "years") right after a disease or risk term, where a life stage, age group or population comes next, as in "fracture in later life" or "cancer in patients".

modes.label: In after a condition
modes.description: The word "in" following a disease or risk phrase, before a group or life stage.
modes.example: risk for osteoporotic fracture<< in>> later life.

modes.label: Later in life
modes.description: The word "later" in "in later life" after a fracture risk statement.
modes.example: risk for osteoporotic fracture in<< later>> life. ( 5.1 )

modes.label: Cancer type or age span
modes.description: A cancer name or a number of years in risk and survival statements.
modes.example: developing ovarian<< cancer>>. BRCA1 and BRCA2
